Emergences AI, Inc.

Government & Law-Enforcement Requests

Version
2026-07-03
Effective
July 3, 2026
Applies to
Emergences

We take the privacy of customer and candidate data seriously, including when a government or law-enforcement body requests it. This policy explains how NeoWork handles such requests.

Contents

  1. 1We require valid legal process
  2. 2We tell affected customers where we can
  3. 3Minimization
  4. 4How to submit a request
1.

We require valid legal process

We disclose data only where compelled by valid legal process appropriate to the data sought, or where an emergency involving a risk of serious harm justifies it. We review requests for legal sufficiency and scope, and push back on overbroad or improper demands.

2.

We tell affected customers where we can

Where the data belongs to a customer's account (including candidate data we process for that customer), our policy is to notify the customer before disclosing, so they can seek to protect their interests — unless we are legally prohibited from doing so, or in an emergency. Where possible, we redirect requesters to the customer as the controller of that data.

3.

Minimization

When we must respond, we disclose the narrowest set of data that is legally required, and keep a record of the request.

4.

How to submit a request

Law-enforcement and government requests should be sent to contact@emergences.ai with the legal basis and scope clearly stated.

End of Government & Law-Enforcement Requests
